description: Fetches and parses IMDb content (movies, TV shows, lists, names) through r.jina.ai reader service

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_movie: Extract movie/TV show info from IMDb title page; requires 'url'; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_list: Extract items from IMDb list page; requires 'url'; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_name: Extract person info from IMDb name page; requires 'url'; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - search: Returns guidance (search not supported via r.jina.ai); 参数: query; 必填: 无

url.description: IMDb URL or ID for get_movie, get_list, or get_name functions. Can be a full URL (http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0185906/) or just the ID (tt0185906). For movies: use /title/ttXXXXXX/ URLs For lists: use /list/lsXXXXXXX/ URLs For names: use /name/nmXXXXXX/ URLs

query.description: Search query (for search function - returns guidance only)
